id: \bWe hope you'll take part in a Bug-Catching Contest in the future!

id: \bThat means the Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
en: \bThat means the Bug-Catching Contest is on today.

id: \bThe rules are simple.

id: \bUsing one of your Pokémon, catch a Bug-type Pokémon to be judged.
en: \bUsing one of your Pokémon, catch a Bug-type Pokémon to be judged.

id: \bPlease choose which Pokémon you want to enter with.
en: \bPlease choose which Pokémon you want to enter with.

id: \bOK. We hope you'll take part in the future.

id: \bThe person who gets the strongest bug Pokémon is the winner.
en: \bThe person who gets the strongest bug Pokémon is the winner.
it: \bVince chi cattura il Pokémon Coleottero più forte.

id: \bYou have 20 minutes.

id: \bIf you run out of Sport Balls, you're done.
en: \bIf you run out of Sport Balls, you're done.

en: \bYou can keep the last Pokémon you catch as your own.
it: \bPuoi tenere l'ultimo Pokémon che catturi.

id: \bGo out and catch the strongest Bug-type Pokémon you can find!
en: \bGo out and catch the strongest Bug-type Pokémon you can find!
it: \bVai e cattura il Pokémon di tipo Coleottero più forte che riesci a trovare!

en: \bWe hold contests regularly in the Park.  You should give it a shot.
